findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step does not identify a vessel and conflates block preheating with reaction heating. Preserve block preheating and reactor placement as unmapped actions; the following HeatChill step already captures the reaction heating.

findings.quote: The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature.
findings.message: The Stir step cannot encode temperature with the allowed fields. Preserve the explicit room-temperature condition with an exact quotation in uncertainties.

findings.quote: THF was removed under reduced pressure
findings.message: Reduced pressure is explicitly required, although no numerical pressure is given. Preserve this condition in uncertainties rather than only noting the missing numerical value.

findings.quote: chromatographic separation with silica gel (20% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)
findings.message: The purification method omits the stated stationary phase and eluent composition. These details appear only in evidence.
The GC/MS completion check is not represented. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the allowed operations do not include analytical monitoring.

patch.value: silica gel chromatography (20% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)
The initial 120-second stirring is explicitly at room temperature, but no numerical temperature is provided: "The reaction mixture was stirred for 2 minutes at room temperature."
Evaporation explicitly requires reduced pressure, but numerical pressure and evaporation temperature are not specified: "THF was removed under reduced pressure".

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: Placement of the microreactor into an already preheated aluminum block is not represented by an allowed operation. Block preheating is an apparatus condition, not a separate heating step for the reaction mixture.
GC/MS monitoring establishes completion before solvent removal; analytical monitoring is not represented by an allowed operation.
